title: USPER Statement about UAP Sighting
doc_notes: This document is an FBI 302 interview report detailing multiple UAP sightings by a helicopter crew and intelligence officials over a US military facility.

incidents.summary: Helicopter crew and intelligence officials observed a 'super-hot' orb hovering at ground level that split into two objects and traveled at high speed.
incidents.quote: spotted an orb under FLIR and described as "super-hot" hovering at ground level

incidents.summary: Helicopter crew and intelligence officials observed a swarm of lights moving in all directions.
incidents.quote: spotting a swarm of lights (too many to count) moving in all directions

incidents.summary: Two large orbs appeared above the helicopter, followed by three more, flaring up and down in sequence.
incidents.color: orange with white or yellow center
incidents.quote: They appeared to be oval shaped, orange in color with a white or yellow center

incidents.summary: Four or five orbs appeared over the mountains, flaring up and down in horizontal formation.
behavior: flaring up and down in horizontal formation
incidents.quote: The orbs flared up one at a time in a horizontal formation

incidents.summary: Orb formation observed to the east, flaring up and down in horizontal formation.
behavior: flaring up and down in horizontal formation
incidents.quote: The orbs flared up one at a time in a horizontal formation

incidents.summary: Single orb observed flaring up and down over the mountain.
incidents.quote: spotted a similar orb flare up west of [SITE CODE NAME] over the mountain

incidents.summary: Swarm of lights observed with three distinct orbs in a triangle formation.
incidents.quote: spotted a swarm of lights moving in all directions with three distinct orbs in a triangle formation

incidents.summary: Five to six orbs observed flaring up and down in horizontal formation.
behavior: flaring up and down in horizontal formation
incidents.quote: five to six orbs flare up IVO [LOCAL TOWN]

incidents.summary: Four orbs observed flaring up and down over military aircraft.
behavior: flaring up and down in horizontal formation
incidents.quote: four orbs flare up over the [MILITARY AIRCRAFT]
